name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA_StDev
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the Volume Weighted MA with Standard Deviation channels indicator. It opens buy positions when the VWMA turns upward or when buy signal dots appear, and sell positions on downward turns or sell dots. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes and standard stop-loss/take-profit controls are provided.
summary_zh: 该EA基于成交量加权均线及标准差通道指标的信号进行交易。当VWMA向上转折或出现买入信号点时开多仓，向下转折或出现卖出信号点时开空仓。支持多种保证金模式和止损止盈控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是成交量加权移动平均线（VWMA）结合标准差通道，利用成交量对价格的加权来识别趋势方向。入场条件支持三种模式：POINT模式通过指标缓冲区2-5的信号点（非EMPTY_VALUE）触发交易；DIRECT模式通过VWMA线的转折判断（买入需当前值大于前值且前值小于更前值，卖出反之）；WITHOUT模式则禁用对应信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓可由卖出信号点或VWMA线下降触发，卖出平仓反之。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持固定手数、按余额比例、按可用保证金比例等多种模式。资金管理依托TradeAlgorithms.mqh库的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen等函数实现。策略使用多系数dK1和dK2控制标准差通道的宽度，配合std_period计算标准差周期，以识别价格偏离均线的程度。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on a Volume Weighted Moving Average (VWMA) combined with Standard Deviation channels, using volume weighting to better identify true trend direction. Entry conditions support three modes: POINT mode triggers trades when signal dots appear in indicator buffers 2-5 (non-EMPTY_VALUE); DIRECT mode detects VWMA line turns (buy when current > previous and previous < the one before, sell on the opposite); WITHOUT mode disables the corresponding signal entirely. Exit conditions mirror the entry modes — buy positions close on sell signal dots or VWMA decline, and sell positions close on buy signal dots or VWMA rise. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting fixed lot size, balance-proportional sizing, and free margin-proportional sizing among other modes. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) for execution. The strategy uses coefficients dK1 and dK2 to scale the Standard Deviation channel width, with std_period defining the lookback for deviation calculation, identifying how far price has deviated from the weighted mean.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot value

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/按余额/按可用保证金等）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss free margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description_en: Price type applied to indicator calculation

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description_en: Indicator offset relative to current bar

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal reading (0=current, 1=last completed)

pros: 成交量加权均线比普通均线更能反映真实价格趋势，减少低成交量时期的虚假信号
支持三种信号模式灵活配置，入场和出场可独立选择不同逻辑，适应不同市场环境
具有完整的止损止盈机制和多种资金管理模式，风险控制手段较为全面
pros_en: Volume-weighted MA better reflects true price trends than simple MAs, reducing false signals during low-volume periods
Three configurable signal modes with independent entry/exit logic selection provide flexibility for different market conditions
Complete stop-loss/take-profit mechanism and multiple money management modes offer comprehensive risk control
cons: 依赖自定义指标Volume_Weighted_MA_StDev，指标文件缺失则EA无法运行，增加了部署复杂度
DIRECT模式下仅通过3根K线的VWMA值简单比较判断转折，容易产生频繁的虚假信号
没有点差过滤、波动率过滤等市场环境检查机制，在高点差或剧烈波动时可能产生不利交易
cons_en: Depends on the custom indicator Volume_Weighted_MA_StDev — if the indicator file is missing the EA fails to initialize, increasing deployment complexity
DIRECT mode uses only a simple 3-bar VWMA comparison to detect turns, which can generate frequent false signals in choppy markets
No spread filter, volatility filter, or other market condition checks — may produce unfavorable trades during high-spread or volatile conditions
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率过滤器，避免在不利市场条件下开仓
增加对指标加载失败的更详细错误日志和自动恢复机制，提升运行稳定性
improvements_en: Add spread and volatility filters to prevent opening positions under unfavorable market conditions
Add more detailed error logging and automatic recovery mechanism for indicator load failures to improve operational stability

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中可能因高滑点产生较大损失
DIRECT模式的VWMA转折判断过于简单，可能频繁触发错误信号导致反复开平仓
risk_points_en: No spread filter — may incur significant losses from high slippage in low-liquidity markets
DIRECT mode VWMA turn detection is overly simplistic, potentially triggering frequent false signals leading to repeated open/close cycles
